name: JunctionRelay
description: Unified data orchestration and IoT device management. Create Junctions to collect data from sources like Unraid, Home Assistant, and APIs, then stream it to local display panels and devices. NOTE: To send data to USB devices on the host machine, you may need to enable privileged mode.

paths.name: Invoice source (host)
paths.description: Optional. A folder of invoice files the server may read when filing a purchase. Read-only on purpose - the server only ever reads from it.

paths.name: Documentation source (host)
paths.description: Optional. A folder of built MkDocs sites the server serves in the Documentation tab. Point it at a directory containing one or more built sites, e.g. a git clone's site/ folder. Read-only on purpose - the server only ever reads from it, and never writes to or clones your repository.

variables.name: Invoice read roots
variables.description: Directories INSIDE the container the lab may read invoice files from, colon or comma separated. Unset means it reads no local paths at all and callers are told to upload instead. Reading arbitrary paths on request would turn a filing tool into a file-disclosure tool, so this is off unless you set it.

variables.name: Documentation roots
variables.description: Directories INSIDE the container the Documentation tab may serve, colon or comma separated. Unset means the tab is off. Serving arbitrary paths on request would turn a docs viewer into a file-disclosure tool, so this is off unless you set it.

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: Optional. How this server is reached on your network, e.g. http://10.0.0.5:7180. Used to print a working upload command when an invoice file is not readable from the server.
